subject: Re: Account status question
text: Further to our earlier exchange, I am writing to request clarification about how the service handles account status checks for student users. When I signed in yesterday, the confirmation page said my subscription was active, but when I opened the main dashboard it displayed a notice stating that the student discount had not yet been verified. The two messages are confusing because the verification email I received two weeks ago said everything had been completed. My main concern is whether the temporary notice will affect my ability to use the service this week. If it does, could you let me know what steps I should take to avoid losing access? I do not want to submit the same documents twice if there is already a record attached to my account. If the issue is only a display problem, please confirm that no action is required. I also noticed that the help center says student verification can take three to five business days, but my case appears to have gone beyond that timeframe. Could someone review the status of the account and tell me whether additional information is needed? For reference, I am using the standard student plan and have not changed any settings recently. The dashboard showed a link to repeat the verification, but I paused rather than follow it. A brief reply is fine; I only need a factual confirmation about whether the account is usable now and whether I should expect any billing difference.
